description: TikTok slideshow skill: plan, write and render TikTok photo-mode slideshows (photo carousels) that market an app, SaaS or product, then post them as native TikTok photo posts (inbox draft or direct) and Instagram carousels to one or many accounts with WoopSocial, read the results back and test the next hooks. Ships a free local slide renderer (Python + Pillow, TikTok Sans and TikTok's own text styles, 1080x1920 with safe zones, plus 4:5 Instagram copies) for your photos, free stock photos or any image model, with full-screen app screenshots; no paid API keys. Use when someone says "tiktok slideshow," "make tiktok slideshows for my app," "tiktok carousel," "photo mode post," "slideshow marketing," "automate tiktok slideshows," "app marketing on tiktok," "post slideshows to several tiktok accounts," or "turn this into a tiktok slideshow." Never promises views, never invents results, reviews or stories, confirms before anything posts. Standalone: needs no other skills.
